report.overall: WETH9.sol implements a minimal wrapped Ether contract with standard deposit/withdraw and ERC20-like functions using Solidity 0.4.18. No high or medium Slither findings reported. The code follows checks-effects-interactions in withdraw and uses events for all state changes.

checklist.note: No owner or privileged roles present in source; all functions are public.
No proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade logic in the contract.
withdraw updates balanceOf before msg.sender.transfer; deposit has no external call.
No price feeds or oracles referenced in code.
Uses unchecked += and -= on balanceOf without SafeMath.
Only uses msg.sender.transfer after state update in withdraw.
No signature verification or EIP-712 logic present.
No pause, stop, or emergency functions defined.
approve and transferFrom implement allowance with uint(-1) infinite check.
Deposit, Withdrawal, Approval, and Transfer events emitted on all mutations.

slither_triage.why: 3 informational issues reported; code matches classic WETH9 pattern with no high/medium findings.
3 optimization issues reported; contract is intentionally minimal for 0.4.18 deployment.

report.overall: TetherToken implements a pausable, blacklistable, upgradable ERC20 with owner-controlled fees and mint/burn but declares non-standard function signatures that omit return values required by ERC20. All 15 Medium Slither findings are interface mismatches stemming from the custom ERC20Basic/ERC20 declarations and forwarding logic in TetherToken. No High findings; the design intentionally deviates from the strict ERC20 spec for legacy and fee reasons.

checklist.note: Ownable with onlyOwner on transferOwnership, pause, unpause, addBlackList, removeBlackList, destroyBlackFunds, deprecate, issue, redeem, setParams.
deprecated flag routes calls to UpgradedStandardToken via transferByLegacy etc.; no proxy pattern, only address swap by owner.
No external calls inside state updates; only internal balance adjustments and events.
No oracles or price feeds present in source.
SafeMath used for mul/div/sub/add in BasicToken and StandardToken; issue/redeem use direct += with require checks.
When deprecated, calls are forwarded to upgradedAddress; no reentrancy guards on those paths.
No signatures or EIP-712 logic in the contract.
Pausable with whenNotPaused on transfer/transferFrom; onlyOwner pause/unpause.
approve enforces zero-then-set but allowance uses MAX_UINT special case; interface mismatch on approve signature.
Transfer, Approval, Pause, Unpause, AddedBlackList, DestroyedBlackFunds, Issue, Redeem, Deprecate, Params emitted.

slither_triage.why: ERC20Basic.transfer, ERC20.transferFrom and approve are intentionally declared without return bool to support fee-on-transfer and legacy forwarding; all 15 findings trace to these declarations at lines 81,91,92,122,167,195,303,311,336,346,365.

report.overall: UniswapV2Factory deploys UniswapV2Pair instances via create2 after checking token addresses and non-existence of getPair[token0][token1], with feeTo and feeToSetter writable only by the setter. The provided source contains the lock modifier, _safeTransfer, _update, mint/burn/swap, and permit logic referenced in the Slither output. One high and five medium findings are reported, concentrated in UniswapV2Pair functions that interact with external token calls and block.timestamp.

checklist.note: setFeeTo and setFeeToSetter require msg.sender == feeToSetter; initialize requires msg.sender == factory; createPair enforces token0 != token1 and getPair[token0][token1] == address(0).
No delegatecall, proxy, or upgrade logic present in UniswapV2Factory or UniswapV2Pair.
lock modifier sets unlocked=0 before external calls in mint/burn/swap; Slither reports state writes after _safeTransfer and IUniswapV2Callee calls in those functions plus createPair.
price0CumulativeLast and price1CumulativeLast updated only from internal reserves using UQ112x112; no external price feed calls.
SafeMath.add/sub/mul used throughout; _update and mint/burn perform explicit overflow checks before casting to uint112.
_safeTransfer performs token.call(SELECTOR) and requires success && (data.length==0 || abi.decode(data,(bool))); swap calls IUniswapV2Callee(to).uniswapV2Call after transfers.
permit checks deadline >= block.timestamp, uses nonces[owner]++, and ecrecover on EIP-712 digest; no other signature handling.
No pause flag, emergency withdrawal, or circuit-breaker logic in any contract.
UniswapV2ERC20 implements approve/transferFrom with allowance check against uint(-1); no factory-level token approvals.
PairCreated emitted on createPair; Mint/Burn/Swap/Sync emitted from pair; no other monitoring hooks.

slither_triage.why: _update computes blockTimestamp = uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) solely to store blockTimestampLast and compute timeElapsed for price accumulators.
_safeTransfer requires success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data,(bool))) matching the standard ERC20 transfer return pattern used in the source.
mint checks _totalSupply == 0 to mint MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY to address(0) on first liquidity addition, as written in the if branch.
swap, burn, and createPair each execute under the lock modifier that sets unlocked=0 before any external call and restores it after state updates.
createPair writes getPair after IUniswapV2Pair(pair).initialize; the lock is not present on factory but the call is the final step before storage writes.
burn performs _safeTransfer then _update under lock; state writes occur only after the protected external calls complete.

report.overall: UniswapV2Router02.sol implements permissionless liquidity and swap functions with deadline checks via ensure modifier and SafeMath usage; no access control, upgradeability, pausing or events are present in the contract. Slither reports 3 High findings on reentrancy-balance and unchecked-transfer plus 6 Medium unused-return issues, all directly matching the listed locations and call patterns in the source. Reentrancy paths exist in the fee-on-transfer swap functions through external pair.swap calls after balance reads.

checklist.note: No owner, admin or role checks present in any function; constructor only sets immutable factory and WETH.
Contract has no proxy, delegatecall or upgradable patterns; deployed as immutable implementation.

Reentrancy-balance flagged in swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens (L554) and swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens (L571) via _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens calling pair.swap after balanceBefore read.
Uses UniswapV2Library.getReserves and quote/getAmountOut internally; no external price oracle calls in provided code.
All arithmetic uses SafeMath for uint; no raw + - * / operators visible outside library calls.
Multiple unchecked external calls including IUniswapV2Pair.transferFrom (L328), createPair (L258) and getReserves (L703) as reported by Slither.
Permit functions forward parameters to pair.permit without additional replay logic in router.
No pause, emergency stop or circuit-breaker state variables or modifiers in source.
removeLiquidity performs IUniswapV2Pair(pair).transferFrom without checking return value (L328); permit paths used for approvals.
No emit statements or event declarations appear in any function of the provided contract source.

slither_triage.why: Matches exact balanceBefore read before _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens and pair.swap at L554 and L571 as reported.
Directly reports ignored return of transferFrom at removeLiquidity L328 in source.
All six instances match deliberate ignores of return values from sortTokens, createPair and getReserves calls shown in code at L248, L318, L427, L536, L701.

report.overall: SwapRouter (contracts/SwapRouter.sol) is a stateless router that executes exactInput/exactOutput swaps via pool callbacks and inherits Multicall, SelfPermit, PeripheryPaymentsWithFee and PeripheryValidation; all state changes occur only through verified pool swaps and pay() calls. No access-control, upgradeability, pausing or events are present in the file. Slither High findings map to inherited PeripheryPayments.pay, Multicall.delegatecall loop and FullMath, all of which match the supplied source patterns.

checklist.note: No owner or privileged functions; constructor only sets immutable factory/WETH9.
Contract has no proxy or upgrade logic; deployed as immutable bytecode.
Multicall uses delegatecall in payable loop; swap callbacks call back into pay().
No price oracles; relies on IUniswapV3Pool.swap return values.
Uses SafeCast and FullMath.mulDiv from dependencies; amountInCached transient storage used for exactOutput.
uniswapV3SwapCallback performs pay() which calls safeTransferFrom and WETH9.transfer; pool.swap is external.
SelfPermit wraps ERC20Permit and IERC20PermitAllowed with standard deadline/nonce checks.
No pause or emergency-stop functions defined.
pay() accepts arbitrary payer and calls TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom; SelfPermitIfNecessary checks allowance.
No events emitted in SwapRouter or inherited base contracts shown.

slither_triage.why: pay() in PeripheryPayments intentionally accepts payer != msg.sender for multihop and permit flows; matches SwapCallbackData.payer usage.
Multicall.multicall explicitly loops over delegatecall to self for batched execution; documented in IMulticall.
Flag points to FullMath.sol line 87 which is not present in supplied SwapRouter or Path/BytesLib sources.
WETH9.transfer and token transferFrom results are ignored after safeTransferFrom wrapper; consistent with PeripheryPayments.pay code.

report.overall: Permit2 (src/Permit2.sol) is a non-upgradeable contract that inherits SignatureTransfer and AllowanceTransfer to provide unified signature-based and allowance-based ERC20 transfers. All high-severity Slither findings reflect intended design for a transfer proxy that performs user-authorized safeTransferFrom calls; medium findings on uninitialized locals are artifacts of conditional EOA vs. ERC1271 paths. No oracles, reentrancy vectors, or upgrade mechanisms are present in the audited files.

checklist.note: Only msg.sender can manage own allowances/nonces; transfers gated by signatures or prior approvals.
No proxy or delegatecall patterns; immutable domain separator cached at construction.
No external calls before state updates that could be re-entered; SafeTransferLib used after nonce/allowance checks.
No price oracles or external data feeds present in source.
All amount checks use explicit comparisons and unchecked blocks only after bounds validation.
safeTransferFrom calls to arbitrary tokens; mitigated by user-signed permits and allowance checks.
EIP-712 + nonceBitmap + sigDeadline prevent replays; _useUnorderedNonce and _updateApproval enforce nonce rules.
No pause or emergency-stop functionality implemented.
approve and permit functions update PackedAllowance with expiration and nonce; lockdown and invalidateNonces provided.
Approval, Permit, Lockdown, NonceInvalidation, and UnorderedNonceInvalidation events emitted on state changes.

slither_triage.why: Transfer functions intentionally call safeTransferFrom(from, ...) where 'from' is the permit signer or allowance owner; this is the core purpose of Permit2.
r,s,v declared at top of verify() but only assigned in EOA branch; contract-signature branch does not use them, so no runtime impact.

report.overall: ENSRegistryWithFallback inherits ENSRegistry and adds fallback reads to an immutable 'old' ENS instance only when recordExists returns false. All state changes remain protected by the authorised modifier and emit the expected events; no high or medium Slither issues were reported. The design intentionally delegates to the legacy contract for unmigrated nodes without introducing reentrancy or arithmetic risks.

checklist.note: authorised modifier in ENSRegistry enforces owner == msg.sender || operators[owner][msg.sender] on all mutating functions; constructor sets root owner to msg.sender.
Contract is not upgradeable; old ENS reference is immutable after constructor and only read in view functions.
No external calls occur inside state-changing functions; all writes are internal or emit events.
No oracles or price feeds present in the provided source.
No arithmetic operations on user-supplied values; only keccak256 and direct assignments.
External calls limited to old.resolver/owner/ttl in view functions when !recordExists(node); no calls in mutators.
No signature verification or replay protection logic in the contract.
No pause or emergency-stop mechanism defined.
No ERC-20/721 approvals or token transfers; only operator approvals for ENS records.
Emits NewOwner, Transfer, NewResolver, NewTTL, and ApprovalForAll exactly as declared in the ENS interface.

Constructor initialization of root node and internal _setOwner/_setResolverAndTTL helpers are flagged but match the intended ENSRegistry behavior.

report.overall: Pool.sol implements the Aave V3 core entrypoint as an upgradeable contract (VersionedInitializable, POOL_REVISION=0x3) that delegates all user actions to libraries while enforcing access via ADDRESSES_PROVIDER, ACLManager, and three custom modifiers. The supplied source contains no reentrancy guards, no events, and no direct arithmetic; all external calls and state updates occur inside the called Logic contracts. Slither reports three High findings (arbitrary-send-erc20 twice, uninitialized-state) plus multiple Medium issues located outside Pool.sol itself.

Inherits VersionedInitializable; getRevision returns POOL_REVISION constant; initialize is protected by initializer modifier.
No ReentrancyGuard or nonReentrant modifier appears in the provided Pool.sol source.
Price oracle address is obtained exclusively via ADDRESSES_PROVIDER.getPriceOracle() and passed into library calls (withdraw, borrow, liquidationCall, etc.).
No arithmetic operations are present in Pool.sol; all calculations reside in the imported Logic libraries.
All state-changing external interactions (supply, borrow, flashLoan, etc.) are forwarded to library functions; the arbitrary-send-erc20 findings are reported in FlashLoanLogic.
supplyWithPermit and repayWithPermit call IERC20WithPermit.permit before executing the logic; deadline and signature values are forwarded unchanged.
No pause or emergency-stop logic is present in the supplied Pool.sol source.
No approve or safeApprove calls appear in Pool.sol.
No emit statements exist in the provided Pool.sol source.

slither_triage.why: FlashLoanLogic._handleFlashLoanRepayment performs safeTransferFrom using params.receiverAddress supplied by the flash-loan caller.
IncentivizedERC20._totalSupply is declared but never initialized inside the provided source; used by totalSupply and _transfer.

Strict timestamp equalities in ReserveLogic.updateState, getNormalizedIncome, getNormalizedDebt and MathUtils.calculateCompoundedInterest are used to short-circuit when no time has elapsed.
